nodes.label: Blind Test icon (musical note + question mark)
nodes.description: White-on-transparent 2000x2000 SVG: a beamed pair of eighth notes with a large question mark overlaid, representing a music blind-test quiz event.
nodes.rationale: Combines the universal music symbol with a question mark so the event (guess the song) is legible at a glance without text.
nodes.norm_label: blind test icon (musical note + question mark)

nodes.label: CrossFit icon (kettlebell lifter + running figure)
nodes.description: White SVG: a kettlebell being held by a figure with arms raised, a stick figure in mid-stride, and a dumbbell/barbell with rounded plates on the ground, evoking a functional-fitness workout.

nodes.label: Dodgeball icon (ball + throwing figure)
nodes.description: White stroke SVG: a ball drawn with curved panel seams (volleyball-style) in the upper right and a thick-stroke stick figure in a dynamic throwing/dodging pose in the lower left.

nodes.label: Hide and Seek icon (person hiding behind tree)
nodes.description: White SVG: a rounded, cloud-shaped tree canopy with a trunk, a small person peeking out from its base, and a second stick figure to the right in a searching/walking pose.
nodes.norm_label: hide and seek icon (person hiding behind tree)

nodes.label: Orienteering icon (compass + walking figure)
nodes.description: White SVG: a large compass rose (circular bezel with four cardinal tick marks and a diagonal needle) and a stick figure walking/hiking in the lower left, representing a map-and-compass navigation event.

nodes.label: Rugby icon (rugby ball with motion trails)
nodes.description: White SVG: an oval rugby ball with a diagonal seam line, accompanied by two sweeping, flame-like motion streaks to the lower right suggesting speed or a kick.
nodes.norm_label: rugby icon (rugby ball with motion trails)

nodes.label: Olympic Warriors logo (OW monogram badge)
nodes.description: 162x154 SVG badge: a black circle offset over a pale-yellow (#F9F3C1) circle to create a drop-shadow effect, with stylized angular 'OW' letterforms in the same pale yellow inside.
nodes.rationale: Two-tone pale yellow (#F9F3C1) on black defines the brand palette; the offset-circle shadow gives depth without gradients.

nodes.label: Olympic Warriors wordmark (title lettering)
nodes.description: 352x245 SVG: blocky, angular custom lettering reading 'OLYMPIC' on the top line and 'WARRIORS' below, filled in pale yellow #F9F3C1 with faceted, isometric-style strokes matching the logo monogram.
nodes.rationale: Uses the same #F9F3C1 fill and angular letter construction as the logo so title and badge read as one identity.
